title: The Raven and the Goose
culture_region: グリーンランド(イヌイット)
text:
Do you know why the raven is so black, so dull and black in colour? It
is all because of its own obstinacy. Now listen.

It happened in the days when all the birds were getting their colours
and the pattern in their coats. And the raven and the goose happened
to meet, and they agreed to paint each other.

The raven began, and painted the other black, with a nice white
pattern showing between.

The goose thought that very fine indeed, and began to do the same by
the raven, painting it a coat exactly like its own.

But then the raven fell into a rage, and declared the pattern was
frightfully ugly, and the goose, offended at all the fuss, simply
splashed it black all over.

And now you know why the raven is black.
paragraphs: Do you know why the raven is so black, so dull and black in colour? It is all because of its own obstinacy. Now listen.
It happened in the days when all the birds were getting their colours and the pattern in their coats. And the raven and the goose happened to meet, and they agreed to paint each other.
The raven began, and painted the other black, with a nice white pattern showing between.
The goose thought that very fine indeed, and began to do the same by the raven, painting it a coat exactly like its own.
But then the raven fell into a rage, and declared the pattern was frightfully ugly, and the goose, offended at all the fuss, simply splashed it black all over.
And now you know why the raven is black.
鴉がどうしてあんなに黒いのか、あんなにくすんだ黒い色をしているのか、知っているかね。すべては鴉自身の意地の張りようのせいなのだ。さあ、お聞き。
それは、鳥たちがみな自分の色と羽の模様をもらっていた頃のことだった。鴉と雁がたまたま出会い、たがいに色を塗り合おうと約束した。
鴉が先に始めて、雁を黒く塗り、あいだにきれいな白い模様が出るようにした。
雁はそれをたいそう見事だと思い、同じように鴉を塗りはじめた。自分とそっくり同じ羽になるように。
ところが鴉は怒り出し、こんな模様はひどく醜いと言い立てた。雁はその騒ぎように腹を立て、そのまま黒一色をばしゃりと浴びせてしまった。
こうして、鴉が黒い理由がわかっただろう。
